hypothesis: Actual native RuVector BGE evidence selection improves the SAME pretrained DeBERTa NLI decoder relative to lexical-top2 and positional-first2 matched controls, on unused document groups and predicates.

runtime_api.constructor: CandidateEngine(artifact_path=None); optional artifact must exactly equal config.json

inputs: Only normalized supplied state/questions; binary choice labels exactly Yes/No. Positive hypothesis from exact supplied criteria.Yes. No task IDs, labels, saved outcomes, retrieval gold or source group lookup.

architecture.encoder: Existing pretrained BGE-small float32 ONNX CLS normalized384D, CPU2
architecture.retrieval: Actual @ruvector/core0.1.33 Cosine VectorDb insert+search every question, observed binary hash required
architecture.decoder: Cached supervised DeBERTa-v3-xsmall NLI quantized ONNX; learned cross-encoder, CPU2, exact2a4f614a...revision
architecture.mapping: Read actual config.id2label. Yes=P(entailment),No=P(contradiction)+P(neutral). Maxentailment pool across2selectedchunks.
architecture.matched_decoder: Identical weights/tokenizer/predicate/K2/pooling/T1 and512token guard in all3arms
architecture.state_context: All state tokenized into192BGEtokenwindows/overlap32. At most64completechunks; longer state fails explicitly, never silently clipped.
architecture.hypothesis_evidence_context: BGE256/NLI512 raw-token guards reject before ONNX inference; every raw/used token count and chunk span reported.
architecture.evidence_cache: At most64 source-only chunkbanks, keys SHA256 over exact chunktext and runtime-pinned encoder/config; no labels. Cachehits and actualembeddings counted.

attribution: Native104 is a whole-pipeline control. SAME-NLI matched controls isolate retrieval evidence selection. NLI is a separately attributed pretrained learned component, not RuVector-trained reasoning weights.
model_history: Same cached NLI weights were used in older experiments/optimization/decision_loop.py. Old public outcomes are not new gains. No model training, model downloads, dependency installs or paid calls in worker.

label_access.only_predicate_metadata_read: legal-transfer/epoch3/predicates.json; final original-archive predicate strings supplied in worker messages

provenance.base_license: Apache-2.0 declared at pinned base-model card; conversion repo has no explicit license declaration

timing_scope: Reports BGE chunks/query and native process/search timing and each actual NLI-arm inference timing. Total request includes native104 + all3decoder arms, not deployment latency of primary alone.
